_color_note: Daedalus Design palette taken from the logo + landing artwork: warm paper background, deep navy-charcoal panels (the logo's navy), navy ink text, and the logo's brushed copper as the single chromatic accent (deep variant is AA-safe for small text on paper; soft variant is for text on dark panels).

layout.grid: full-viewport snap sections (100svh, scroll-snap mandatory), content max-width 1152px, 24px side padding

voice: Confident and concise. No hype, no exclamation points. Serbian first, English second.
signature_element: Liquid-glass surfaces (Apple-style translucent blur) on the floating pill navbar, buttons and card chrome, with the logo's copper as hover/accent color. Rounded-full pills and rounded-2xl cards throughout.
